reasons: A establishes the delivery constraints before sizing (deadline + continuation, builder count/hours/ADK-GCP familiarity, budget, audience); B omits the team/skill question and folds deadline into a vague 'time and money' question.

A ties risk to both data sensitivity (real vs anonymised, prod vs sandbox) and write scope with a one-word 'defaults' reply path; B covers write scope and idempotency well but skips the data/environment question.
